info.title: Machine Library API
info.description: Search, retrieve, and synthesize scholarly and public-interest documents through Machine Library, the search and AI product by Space Frontiers Company. Document recognition endpoints (`/v1/recognitions`: PDF, EPUB, and DJVU to structured Markdown) share this host and are described at `/v1/recognitions/docs/openapi.json`; the site reference at https://machinelibrary.ai/docs/api/reference presents both specs merged.

duplicate.description: True when `comment_id` was already used; nothing new was stored.

AgentCommentSubmission.description:
Public `POST /v2/search/comments` body: the comment plus the search
receipt that returned the document.

comment_id.description:
Caller-generated UUID, reused on retries; repeated submissions return
the original comment.

BridgeArm.description:
`off`: no bridge; `passages`: hops from first-round passages only;
`ontology`: recalled relations first, then passages.

BridgeStep.description:
One bridge hop: the intermediate a first-round source states, the
follow-up search, and how many documents it returned once finished.

cited.description: Whether the answer cited any of the hop's documents.

recalled.description: Stated by the ontology rather than a first-round document.

ByUriResponse.description:
by-uri endpoints return either a document or (with `text_filter`) a
search response, matching the Python union return type.

document.description: Absent field data is omitted; valid zero and negative scores are retained.

citation_index.description: Zero-based position among citation markers in the answer.

excerpt.description: Claim-specific excerpt suitable for citation previews.

snippet_index.description: Zero-based index into the selected document's snippets.

quote.description:
Short verbatim excerpt supporting the comment; at least one evidence
item of a comment carries one.

uri.description:
A source the agent inspected: https URL or doi://, arxiv://, pubmed://,
pmc://, isbn:// identifier.

CommentStats.description: Visible comments (not deleted, approved authors) on one document.

contributions.description: Comments with a kind, by kind, most comments first.

votes.description: Sum of votes over those comments.

user_vote.description:
The account's vote on the comment afterwards: 1, -1, or 0 when a
reader withdrew it.

Contribution.description:
What a comment says about the document. The kinds do not overlap: take
the first that applies — correction (the paper or its record is wrong),
contradicts / supports (independent work tests the same claim), limitation
(a weakness visible in the paper itself), related work (other work that
neither confirms nor refutes), review (an appraisal across several points),
question (people only). Optional for people, required for agents.

votes.description: Sum of votes over these comments.

is_shared.description:
The owner shared it: anyone with the link can read it, only the owner
can continue it.

oneOf.description:
Staff-only evaluation arm for bridge retrieval; ignored for everyone
else, who get the deployment's setting.

document_ids.description:
Exact Nexus documents to merge into retrieval regardless of the query
classifier. `default` keeps historical persisted steps compatible.

max_model_documents.description:
Cap on documents sent to the model after reranking and budget
stripping (pinned documents keep priority). Experimentation knob for
quality/cost sweeps; absent or zero means no cap.

citations.description:
Ordered metadata for every inline citation marker, including repeated
citations to different passages of the same document.

oneOf.description: Persisted search-stage snapshot, captured only for entitled planning.

agent_reads_7d.description: MCP agents fetched the document or searched inside it.

as_of_at.description: Snapshot time (Unix seconds); null when the document has no recorded activity.

views_7d.description: Page views, once per visitor and UTC day.

DocumentActivityResponse.description: Activity counters plus the document's visible comments.

new_query.description: Replacement query for the selected request step.

FeatureContract.description: Feature identity includes query construction, not only column names.

candidate_depth.description: Fixed per-branch, per-shard nomination depth for this feature population.

phrase_policy.description: Whole query phrase plus mean of explicit quoted-span phrase scores.

tokenizer_policy.description: Single language hint using indexed original forms when undetermined.

backfill.description: Preserve organic scores and probe only missing cells when enabled.

formula.description: Summa symbolic expression over named raw branch scores and organic `rrf`.

missing_values.description: Finite raw defaults for absent formula variables. Observed zero wins.

Query.description: Classifier state object (the retired Python client's `Query`).

date.description: `[start, end]` as Unix seconds in JSON.

date_expression.description:
Unresolved classifier expression; cached instead of absolute timestamps
so relative ranges are evaluated at request time.

bridge.description: Intermediates a dependent question was answered through, in hop order.

oneOf.description: The planner's plan kind (`dependent` questions may bridge).

RankingMode.description:
Relevance objective, independent of corpus and lexical/vector retrieval.
Results remain document groups for both objectives.

ReferencedBy.description: One identifier or several identifiers of the same cited work.

ordinal.description: Omit for document relevance; specify a returned chunk for passage relevance.

relevance.description: 0 irrelevant, 1 tangential, 2 useful but partial, 3 directly relevant.

SearchDocument.description: One search hit: the stored document plus its snippets and score.

feedback_id.description: Caller-generated UUID, reused on retries. Analytics deduplicates by this ID.

binary_pool.description:
Benchmarks: merge a binary-only retrieval pool into the reranker pool
of a documents-corpus search with L2 (default `false`).

candidate_ranking.description:
Candidate selection before the cross-encoder. Formula requires an
explicit model or an artifact configured for the query's ranking profile.

combiner_decay.description: Rank decay applied by the combiner.

combiner_top_k.description: Number of sub-query ranks considered by the combiner.

cross_rerank.description:
Final-stage hosted cross-encoder reranker. On by default; pass `false`
to skip it. No-op unless the reranker is configured
(`reranker.enabled`). Runs after Summa candidate selection.

cross_rerank_candidates.description:
Override the number of candidates retrieved and reranked (0 = config
default). Capped at `MAX_CROSS_RERANK_POOL`.

document_discovery.description:
Benchmarks: force (`true`) or disable (`false`) merging a whole-document
L2 pool into a passages search's reranker pool. Omit for the default,
which merges for automatic passage searches.

filter_issued_after.description: Earliest issue time as a Unix timestamp.

filter_issued_before.description: Latest issue time as a Unix timestamp.

filter_languages.description: Restrict results to ISO language codes.

filter_uri_prefixes.description: Restrict results to canonical URI prefixes.

fulltext_phrase_boost.description:
Extra weight for exact phrase matches inside the BM25 branch (default
1.0). Zero disables the bonus while keeping quoted phrase constraints.

fulltext_weight.description:
Weight of the stemmed BM25 (full-text) channel in hybrid fusion; `0`
disables it. Omit for the service default (1.0). Takes effect only on
indexes whose schema carries the text fields.

include_candidate_scores.description:
Include raw document/passage features for formula-ranked returned hits.
Training collection uses the separate complete-union export path.

include_rrf_scores.description: Include exact organic RRF votes alongside fusion results.

index_names.description: Logical indexes to search. Public values are `documents` and `social`.

oneOf.description:
Symbolic formula over named raw scores and organic `rrf`.
Missing raw cells use defaults; references to absent branches fail validation.

l2_rerank.description:
Search API CatBoost selection before the cross-encoder. Auto activates
a configured profile; off is the control. Catboost requires a model.

limit.description: Maximum number of hits to return.

max_query_dims.description: Maximum number of reformulated query dimensions; zero uses the service default.

oneOf.description: Retrieval strategy. Hybrid combines lexical and semantic retrieval.

possible_languages.description: Language hints used by query processing.

query.description:
Natural-language query (at most 16 KiB UTF-8). Wrap a span in double
quotes (`"float-zero determinants"`) to require ordered indexed tokens.
Straight, curly and guillemet pairs work; all quoted spans are required
and receive a lexical score bonus. Tokenizer normalization still applies.
Unquoted words guide relevance; use structured parameters for filters.
Quoted identifiers are text constraints, not direct lookup requests.
An empty query can be combined with filters.

oneOf.description:
Relevance objective: passages ranks answer-bearing passages and their
document groups; documents ranks sources for researching the topic.
Auto resolves intent to one of those two objectives. The response reports
the resolved mode. Corpus selection is independent.

Return documents that cite this work: one `doi://`/`arxiv://` URI or
a list of up to 16 identifiers of the same work.

return_documents.description:
Include enriched document metadata and query-matched snippets. Set to
false for bulk ranking jobs that only need document IDs and scores.

rrf_k.description:
RRF smoothing constant for hybrid fusion. Omit for the service
default (60, the original-paper value); smaller values weight
top-ranked results more aggressively.

sparse_nomination.description:
Whether the sparse branches nominate candidates (`false` keeps them as
ranking features only). Omit for the default: on for passage ranking,
off for whole-document ranking.

tracing.description: Return bounded per-shard and per-vertical execution traces.

feedback_token.description: A bounded, expiring capability to rate results of this retrieval.

document_id.description: Source document whose whole-document representation seeds similarity retrieval.

filter_languages.description: Restrict results to ISO language codes.

Snippet.description: One highlighted passage of a search hit.

table_header.description:
Caption, header and separator rows of the Markdown table this passage
continues, when the passage starts mid-table. Context only: it lies
outside `text` and its `source` coordinates.
